extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Single-pass extraction from NCT04677179_soa.pdf (Protocol J1P-MC-KFAH(b)). Marks read from pdftotext -bbox tokens binned to header column centres and checked visually against 110-dpi renders of every page. The abbreviation block below the table yields no annotations (no in-grid markers).

table_metadata.table_title: Table 1. Schedule of Activities for the Screening and Induction Treatment Periods of Study J1P-MC-KFAH
table_metadata.table_purpose: Screening (V1) and induction treatment (V2-V9, Weeks 0-12) schedule for all participants
table_metadata.notes: Primary anchor schedule. Label column L=1 (activity name); data columns V1-V9 at positions 2-10; right-hand Comment column is a notes column (not a schedule column) whose cells are emitted as footnote annotations. Pages 18,21,22,23 (PDF 2,5,6,7) are full-page raster images with a glyph-spread text layer; pages 17,19,20 are vector text. Rows whose label is covered by a 'CCI' redaction box are transcribed with activity_name 'CCI'.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Visit identifiers V1 (screening) and V2-V9 (induction); named visits, so property_type visit.
Week offset from randomization (-5 at screening, dash at V2/randomization, then 1-12); week numbers, so property_type week.
Protocol study day (dash for screening, Day 1 at V2 through Day 85 at V9); property_type study_day.
Allowed visit window in days (V1 up to 35 days before V2; ±3 days for V3-V9); property_type window.

Shaded bold header-band row reprinted on every page marking the visits at which the participant attends fasting (X at V2 and V9). A visit attribute rather than a timing level; typed modality for consistency across the corpus (the taxonomy has no property type for a visit attribute); does not distinguish columns, so hierarchical_level null.

review_items.call_made: The shaded 'Fasting visit' band (X at V2 and V9, reprinted on every page) is recorded as a header schedule_property, not as an activity row; the same treatment is applied in Tables 2-4.
review_items.alternative: Record 'Fasting visit' as a level-0 activity row carrying X marks at the fasting visits.

review_items.call_made: The title-cell instruction 'V1 and V9 procedures may be conducted over more than 1 day…' is bound to the V1 and V9 cells of the Visit number row (by the visits it names).
review_items.alternative: Treat it as a table-wide note bound to the Visit number property row as a whole.

review_items.call_made: Rows printed above the first section header (Informed consent … Alcohol and caffeine use) are recorded at indentation level 0 as stand-alone activities with marks; the same convention is used for the ungrouped top rows of Tables 2-4.
review_items.alternative: Record them at level 1 as children of an implicit, unnamed general group.
